_case: Experiment: n-hexane steam cracking in the Ghent LPT pilot coil. Van Geem et al., AIChE J. 52, 718-730 (2006); numbers from K. Van Geem's PhD thesis (Ghent 2006, biblio.ugent.be/publication/470983), Table 2.6 and section 4.5
_run: CIT 873 K, COT 997 K, CIP 0.27 MPa, COP 0.24 MPa, n-hexane 4.0 kg/h, steam 0.4 kg/kg; measured conversion 51.5 %
_geometry: reaction section 12.4 m, internal diameter 9 mm (thesis section 4.5; its chapter 2 says 'd = 10 mm' in passing)
_models: v1.1 = ReactionRateNET v1.1 (models/v1.1). The older models/ratenet (epoch 40) is far off at these conditions: 83 % conversion
_gas_temperature_profile: ASSUMED linear from CIT to COT: the thesis simulated with the 20 measured thermocouple readings but does not print them
_pressure_profile: ASSUMED linear from CIP to COP (5 manometers along the coil, readings not printed)
_experiment_yields_wtpct: thesis Table 2.6, wt% of the n-hexane fed. C6H14 = 100 - conversion 51.5; C4H8 = 1-butene 5.8 + 2-butene 0.4; C5H10 is 1-pentene only, the model sums all C5H10 isomers
